name: ComposeOverviewV1
steps: call LLD-03/05/06/07/08/09 providers with that same snapshot and window
validate every provider contract_version and result bounds
construct four cards in fixed order Tickets,Objectives,Inventory,SLA Health
compute TrendValueV1 only from owner-provided current/previous counts
merge owner AttentionItemV1 values and rank with NeedsAttentionRankingV1
merge bounded timeline/activity values using their deterministic order
render at most eight narrative items through NarrativeRendererV1
return provider coverage/freshness metadata and snapshot_as_of_utc
rules: coverage unknown/partial/unconfigured remains data and does not become zero
Overview never queries rejected/deferred proposal rows as accepted facts
no provider or composition step may request Resolved Status Date
no write, job enqueue, audit insert or domain command occurs
